Backgammon League

Privacy policy

Last updated: 28 October 2026

This policy explains what information Backgammon League uses, why we use it, who receives it, how long we keep it and the choices you have. Backgammon League is intended only for adults aged 18 and over.

Who we are

Backgammon League is operated by Panayiotis Panaretos, an individual developer based in Cyprus, who is the data controller responsible for the personal data used to provide the app. Contact: panayiotiskpanaretos@gmail.com.

Information we use

Without an account: guest games, practice results and preferences are stored only on your device. They are not sent to us.

Your account: creating an account uses an email address and password or a supported sign-in provider, such as Google or Facebook. Depending on the provider and your choices, it may share your email address, name, profile picture and a provider identifier with us. Our authentication provider stores your login details and sessions.

Your game profile and activity: your username and tag, chosen avatar or uploaded picture, level, XP, rating, rank, borders and game statistics. We also store friend requests, friendships, notifications, game invitations, the moves and results of online games, your gold balance and gold transactions.

Purchases: when you buy gold or the ad-free subscription, we store a billing identifier linked to your account, store transaction identifiers, purchase and refund events and your subscription status. We never receive or store your full payment card details; payment is handled by the app store or payment provider.

Technical information: our hosting, sign-in, payment and advertising providers receive the technical information needed to run their services, such as IP address, device and browser type, request times and error or security information.

Why we use it

To provide the app you asked for: your account, profile, friends, online games, fair results, ratings, gold, purchases and ad-free access. The legal basis is performing our agreement with you.

To keep the service secure and working: preventing cheating, fraud and abuse, protecting accounts and fixing errors. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in a safe and reliable service.

To meet legal obligations, such as keeping accounting and tax records for purchases.

To show advertising, where you have given consent if consent is required. See Advertising below.

Advertising

The app shows ads in menus and between games, never during an active game. Ads are provided by Google AdMob in the mobile apps and Google AdSense on the website. An active ad-free subscription removes all ads.

We request non-personalised ads. These are not based on your past behaviour, but the ad provider may still use device storage, advertising or device identifiers, approximate location from your IP address, and ad interactions for frequency limits, measurement and fraud prevention.

Where the law requires consent, Google's consent message asks for it before ads are requested. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time under Advertising privacy choices in Settings or on the Privacy page. Refusing consent does not stop you playing.

Who receives information

Other players see the game identity needed to play with you: your username, tag, avatar, border, level, rank and results in shared games, friend requests and invitations. Your email address and login details are never shown to other players, and there is no public directory of profiles or balances.

Service providers process information for us: Supabase (accounts, database and picture storage), RevenueCat (purchase verification and subscription status), Google (AdMob and AdSense advertising), Apple, Google Play or the web payment provider (checkout), the sign-in provider you choose, and our server hosting and email providers. They may only use it to provide their services.

Provider privacy policies: Supabase (https://supabase.com/privacy), RevenueCat (https://www.revenuecat.com/privacy) and Google (https://policies.google.com/privacy). We do not sell your personal information.

We may disclose information if the law requires it or to protect players and the service from fraud or abuse.

Where information is stored

Our account database and picture storage are hosted by Supabase in London, United Kingdom. Some providers, including Google and RevenueCat, may process information in the European Economic Area, the United States or other countries. Where information leaves the UK or the European Economic Area, we rely on the safeguards in the providers' data-protection terms, such as an adequacy decision or the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.

How long we keep information

Account and profile information is kept while your account exists.

When you delete your account, we remove your login, email address, username, profile picture, friendships, friend requests and notifications. Deletion of a few items, such as stored pictures, finishes in the background shortly afterwards. We also ask RevenueCat to delete your billing customer record.

Completed online games remain part of your opponents' game history. After you delete your account they show a Deleted player identity instead of your username and picture.

Gold and purchase records are kept for six years from the deadline for filing the tax return covering the transaction, or from the actual filing date if later, and longer only where another law requires it. They are needed for accounting, tax, refunds and preventing a purchase from being granted twice. After account deletion they stay linked only to the Deleted player identity and an internal identifier, not your name, email or picture.

Support emails are kept as long as needed to handle your request and any follow-up.

Information on your device stays until you clear the app's or browser's storage or uninstall the app. Deleting your account removes that account's saved games on the device you use to delete it.

Our providers may keep backup copies for disaster recovery for a limited time. Deleted information disappears from those copies when they expire.

Security

Private records can only be read by their owner, enforced by database access rules. Uploaded pictures are checked, re-encoded to remove hidden metadata such as location, stored privately and shown to other players through links that expire.

Connections are encrypted. Payment verification and privileged credentials stay on our server, and we never log passwords, session tokens or payment secrets. No system is perfectly secure, but we work to protect your information and will act on any security issue we discover.

Age requirement

Backgammon League is only for people aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone younger. If you believe someone under 18 has created an account, contact panayiotiskpanaretos@gmail.com and we will delete it.

Your rights and choices

You can ask for a copy of your personal data (including in a portable format), its correction or deletion, or restriction of its use, and you can object to processing based on our legitimate interests. Email panayiotiskpanaretos@gmail.com from the address linked to your account. We reply within one month and may need to confirm your identity first. Never send your password, sign-in codes or payment card details.

You can delete your account at any time in Settings > Delete account. See the account deletion page for details. Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription; manage subscriptions in the app store or payment provider you used.

Where we rely on consent, you can withdraw it at any time; this does not affect anything done before. You can also complain to your local data-protection authority. In Cyprus this is the Commissioner for Personal Data Protection (https://www.dataprotection.gov.cy/).

Changes to this policy

We will update this policy when the way the app uses information changes, and change the date above. If a change is significant, we will tell you in the app before it applies.
